name: bizplug-saas
description: The saas & software plug-in from BizPlug. Main function: book a product demo. It works from the business's own published profile, covering features, integrations, plans pages and demo requests, and sends requests to the business to confirm. It never takes payment and only shares what the business has published. Provided by BizPlug: https://www.bizplug.ai, info@bizplug.ai.

interface.shortDescription: Book a product demo for saas & software businesses.
interface.longDescription: The saas & software plug-in from BizPlug. Main function: book a product demo. It works from the business's own published profile, covering features, integrations, plans pages and demo requests, and sends requests to the business to confirm. defaultPrompt: Does it integrate with our CRM, and what does it cost?
How do I contact the business?

test_cases.expect: Calls show_menu, which shows the menu card; does not list the options again, or lists them exactly as returned where there is no card.
Calls find_demo_slots and answers from the published profile.

test_cases.prompt: Does it integrate with our CRM, and what does it cost?
test_cases.expect: Answers from the business profile, or says it is not covered and offers contact details.
Calls request_demo only after the customer has confirmed the details, and reports that the business still has to confirm.
Calls get_pricing and shows the published plans, or only the pricing page when the product shows no plans; never invents a price or offers a subscription.

test_cases.prompt: How do I connect my CRM?
test_cases.expect: Calls search_help (or get_features) and gives the matching guide with its link, or says none is published.

test_cases.prompt: Write me a poem about the ocean.
